messages:
Maria G.: Heads up — forecasting spike for Nov/Dec looks like 2.6x baseline for chat workloads in eu-west. Need to review burst policy and guardrails before next planning sync. cc @kevin @samir
Kevin L.: Thanks. Is that 2.6x GPU-hours or token throughput?
Maria G.: GPU-hours. Derived from per-request token counts + expected sessions. I pushed the spreadsheet here: https://redwood-console/internal/forecasts/nov-dec — note it's higher in night windows due to APAC conversions.
Samir: If it's GPU-hours, we need to cap burst so steady-state reserved capacity covers 80% and burst can add tolerable 20% on demand. Otherwise cost explodes with spot/ondemand churn.
Devon: Can we use warm pools to reduce cold-start tail latencies during bursts instead of spinning new nodes? That reduces GPU-hours somewhat.
Kevin L.: Yes — warm pools already reduce startup from ~2m to ~20s. But they still consume vGPU reservation if kept hot. We should tighten burst window (currently 15m) to 3m and reduce per-customer burst quota.
Maria G.: Proposal: steady-reserve = forecast * 1.15 (safety), burst-cap = min(0.25*pool, 50 GPUs), burst-window = 3m, cooldown = 10m. Also add per-org burst throttles per-account.
Samir: Sounds reasonable. We need to validate with load tests. I'll run the synthetic harness against eu-west with scaled request mix.
Samir: ```
./tools/loadgen --profile chat --qps 800 --duration 30m --region eu-west --tokens 250
```
sre-bot: Alert: eu-west cluster CPU trending 85% during test, p95 latency 1.1s, pod restarts 2.
Devon: Pod restarts indicate OOM on some quantized kernels — file bug with stack and kernel args. For autoscaling, we should add node.k8s.io/gpuReady metric to avoid scheduling while warm pool initializing.
Kevin L.: Cost note from finance-bot: projected monthly delta for 25% burst usage = +$160k. Finance recommends stricter per-customer burst throttles and chargeback.
Maria G.: Decision checklist: a) tighten burst-window to 3m b) burst-cap rule as proposed c) add warm-pool sizing to autoscaler d) enforce per-org quotas e) run two full-load tests (eu-west and us-west). Who owns implementation?
Samir: I'll own load tests + PR to autoscaler rules. Kevin can own quota UI + API. Devon handles kernel bug.
Kevin L.: :thumbsup: I'll add a quick feature flag so we can flip policy in staging.
Maria G.: Thanks — target rollout to staging by Mon, monitor for two weeks, then prod canary in first week of Nov. Recording notes in incidence tracker: https://redwood-console/incidents/seasonal-burst-2026
